children: Brazil's Finance Minister Dario Durigan said on Friday the government could maintain fuel subsidies in 2027 if there is fiscal room and Brent crude prices remain elevated.
Durigan added in an interview with news outlet UOL that Brazil could not rule out extending taxes on oil exports into next year, depending on diesel price trends and market conditions.
Brazil announced fuel subsidies in March amid volatility in international oil and fuel prices triggered by the U.S.-Israeli conflict with Iran.
